text:
## Endpoint Security  
### Laptops & Desktops  
**Antivirus/Anti-malware:**
- Endpoint detection and response (EDR) tool deployed
- Real-time scanning enabled
- Virus definitions updated daily
- Suspicious behavior isolated automatically  
**Device Management:**
- Mobile Device Management (MDM) for phones/tablets
- Encryption enforced on all devices
- Lost device remote wipe capability
- OS patches applied within 30 days (critical within 7)  
**Full-Disk Encryption:**
- BitLocker (Windows), FileVault (Mac)
- Encryption keys escrowed (recovery)
- Mandatory for all devices with customer data access

raw_entities.name: Endpoint Security Policy
raw_entities.description: A formal policy governing the security requirements for laptops, desktops, and mobile devices. It defines the standards for malware protection, device management, and data encryption to protect bank and customer data.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory EDR Deployment and Real-time Scanning
raw_entities.description: Requires the deployment of an Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tool with real-time scanning enabled to protect endpoints.
context: Endpoint detection and response (EDR) tool deployed

raw_entities.name: Daily Virus Definition Updates
raw_entities.description: Mandates that virus definitions for endpoint security tools must be updated on a daily basis.

raw_entities.name: Automatic Isolation of Suspicious Behavior
raw_entities.description: Requires that any behavior identified as suspicious by security tools must be isolated automatically.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Mobile Device Management
raw_entities.description: Requires the use of Mobile Device Management (MDM) for all phones and tablets used within the bank's environment.

raw_entities.name: Universal Device Encryption
raw_entities.description: Mandates that encryption must be enforced on all devices, specifically those with access to customer data.
context: Mandatory for all devices with customer data access

raw_entities.name: Remote Wipe Capability for Lost Devices
raw_entities.description: Requires that all devices have the capability to be wiped remotely in the event they are lost.

raw_entities.name: OS Patching Timeframes
raw_entities.description: Defines the mandatory window for applying OS patches: within 30 days for standard patches and within 7 days for critical patches.
context: OS patches applied within 30 days (critical within 7)

raw_entities.name: Encryption Key Escrow
raw_entities.description: Requires that encryption keys for full-disk encryption be escrowed to ensure recovery is possible.

raw_entities.name: Malware Risk
raw_entities.description: The risk of malicious software infecting endpoints, addressed through EDR, real-time scanning, and daily updates.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Data Access
raw_entities.description: The risk of unauthorized parties accessing customer data via lost or stolen devices, mitigated by encryption and remote wipe capabilities.
context: Mandatory for all devices with customer data access

raw_entities.name: Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
raw_entities.description: A technical tool deployed to detect and respond to threats on laptops and desktops.
context: Endpoint detection and response (EDR) tool deployed

raw_entities.name: Mobile Device Management (MDM)
raw_entities.description: A management system used to enforce security policies on mobile phones and tablets.

raw_entities.name: Full-Disk Encryption
raw_entities.description: The use of BitLocker for Windows and FileVault for Mac to ensure data at rest is encrypted.
